lines.text: The LORD tells David's Lord to sit at His right hand until He makes His enemies a footstool.
The LORD extends the mighty scepter of David's Lord from Sinai and says to rule among His enemies.
On His day of battle, the people of David's Lord shall be willing.
The LORD swears and will not change His mind: David's Lord is a priest forever in the order of Aaron.
The Lord at His right hand will crush kings in His wrath, judge the nations, and drink from the brook.
